title: Push-further analysis: BM24 saddle dominance across gamma range
convention: full_conv2_exponent = Re_Phi_M + phi_pref_conv2; delta = comp - seed; lambda_abs = log|P_n|/n

push_1_dense_onset_scan.description: Dense scan gamma in [-0.65, -1.30] to pin down onset of branches 43/46 and crossover
push_1_dense_onset_scan.method: n_max=40 (n=[36-40]) lambda_abs vs seed and branch43/46 full_conv2_exponent
push_1_dense_onset_scan.result: Seed is the best match to exact lambda at ALL gamma in [0, -1.82] at n=40
push_1_dense_onset_scan.note: Branch 43/46 exist from gamma~-1.08/-1.27 but are NOT the best match to lambda until gamma<-1.83

high_re_competitors.interpretation: Large Im Phi (not real saddles); likely not on physical integration cycle

push_2_3_im_phi_analysis.description: Im Phi comparison: seed vs branches 43/46; Stokes line diagnostic

seed_im_phi.values: Im Phi ~ 0.006-0.56 for gamma in [-6.26, -3.81]; jumps to ~2pi at gamma~-3.76; stays ~6.05-6.28 (~2pi) for gamma in [-3.7, -1.2]
seed_im_phi.mod_2pi: Im Phi_seed = 0 (mod 2pi) throughout — seed is on real locus
seed_im_phi.branch_cut_jump: 2pi branch cut at gamma ~ -3.76; equivalent Im Phi mod 2pi is unchanged

branch43_im_phi.values: Im Phi ~ 0 (< 0.001) for gamma in [-6.28, -1.82]; rises to ~0.32 near onset at -1.08
branch43_im_phi.interpretation: Branch 43 is a real saddle throughout its range

branch46_im_phi.values: Im Phi in [-0.15, 0]; essentially zero for gamma in [-6.28, -1.7]
branch46_im_phi.interpretation: Branch 46 is also a real saddle; negative Im Phi is conjugate to branch 43

push_2_3_im_phi_analysis.delta_im_seed_minus_43: ~-2pi (mod 2pi = 0) throughout overlap — no Stokes wall between them
push_2_3_im_phi_analysis.conclusion: All three saddles (seed, branch43, branch46) are on the real locus Im Phi = 0 mod 2pi. Competition is purely in Re Phi. No Stokes suppression of branches 43/46.

push_4_n_max_convergence.description: Lambda_abs(n) convergence with n up to 40 at key gamma values

results.trend: lambda converging toward seed_exp (~-0.474) as n grows
lambda converging to b43_exp (~-0.681); seed 0.050 below
lambda converging monotonically to b43_exp = phi_pref+0 = -0.6896; gap at n=40 is 0.00046

crossover_analysis.interpretation: Robust dominance crossover (n>=30) at gamma ~ -1.83 rad (~ -0.58pi). Seed controls QAOA-relevant range gamma in [0, -1.83]; branches 43/46 control larger |gamma|.

physical_interpretation.at_large_gamma: Re Phi_43 = Re Phi_46 ~ 0 for gamma < -2.5; full_conv2_exponent ~ phi_pref = -0.6896. Lambda_abs at n=40 converges to phi_pref within 0.001 at gamma=-3.0. The QAOA success probability decays as exp(n * phi_pref) = exp(-0.6896 n), not as predicted by seed.
physical_interpretation.at_qaoa_optimal: At typical p=1 optimal gamma ~ -0.8 to -1.5 rad, seed controls. Seed gap < 0.009 at n=40 — asymptotic approximation holds with ~1% relative error.
physical_interpretation.algebraic_vs_physical_dominance: High-Re competitors (branches 150, 180, 193, 197 etc.) are algebraically dominant but NOT finite-n explanatory — they are on non-physical log sheets (Im Phi ~ 5-8, not near 0 mod 2pi). Branches 43/46 ARE on the physical sheet and ARE finite-n explanatory.
physical_interpretation.stokes_geometry: No Stokes line between seed and branches 43/46 (delta Im Phi = 0 mod 2pi throughout). The crossover at gamma~-1.83 is an anti-Stokes crossing (Re Phi becomes equal), not a Stokes event.

summary_answer.does_seed_remain_dominant: Yes, within QAOA-relevant range gamma in [0, -1.83]
summary_answer.where_does_seed_lose_dominance: gamma ~ -1.83 rad (~-105 degrees). Below this, branches 43/46 control.
summary_answer.is_asymptotic_approximation_valid: Yes at QAOA-relevant angles. Single saddle dominates; seed gap < 1% of lambda at n=40.
summary_answer.what_controls_at_large_gamma: Complex conjugate pair branches 43/46 with Re Phi ~ 0 (near-trivial saddles). Exponent converges to phi_pref_conv2 = -0.6896 as gamma -> -2pi.
